title: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Dry Bulk Report - November 10, 2026
section_path: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Dry Bulk Report - November 10, 2026
section_path_text: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Dry Bulk Report - November 10, 2026
summary:
Main
• Capesize Spot Rates Back Above 30,000 as Seasonality Kicks In - Although November has traditionally served as a strong period for dry bulk shipping, the recent recovery in spot rates actually commenced earlier than usual in mid-October, defying historical trends that typically point to late-month softness. Looking ahead, we anticipate sustained strength across the spot market for the remainder of November. This bullish momentum is further reflected in the futures curve, where December contracts are once again rallying toward the 40,000 mark and firstquarter pricing remains historically elevated.
